name: patch_const_1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
src=open('src/ZeckConst.lean').read()
o="""  congr 1
  refine tsum_congr (fun j => ?_)
  unfold aT
  have e : 2 * (j + 2) = 2 * j + 4 := by ring
  rw [e]
"""
assert o in src
src=src.replace(o,"  congr 1\n")
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/ZeckConst.lean'],input=src,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
